verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents SOC 2 as a supported framework, controls added automatically per framework, Formal and Comprehensive policy templates, and Fieldwork evidence collection. A vCISO helps build the SOC 2 program, and there is an Auditor API. None of the evidence names Type I versus Type II audits, maps controls to the Trust Services Criteria, or describes an auditor evidence-request workflow. missing for 10: explicit Type I and Type II program support, Trust Services Criteria control mapping, documented auditor evidence-request handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a SOC 2 program end to end — Type I and Type II — with the Trust Services controls, required policies, and evidence requests built into the platform

citations.quote: Whether you need SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, or another framework. Oneleet's all-in-one platform simplifies your compliance journey.
Removing a framework also removes unused controls that were automatically added for it.
Formal (Minimum Viable Policies): These templates cover essential security guidelines. Comprehensive: These are more detailed policies that include stricter requirements
Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
Oneleet maps your external infrastructure, identifies risks, and generates SOC 2 evidence, continuously.
Leverage Oneleet as your security team with a dedicated vCISO to create your SOC 2 program & help you pass security reviews.
